---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary
A short description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve, or what player experience does it improve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature in as much detail as you can. Include:
- What the player sees / does
- Where in the UI or console it would appear
- Any new settings or keybinds involved

## Alternatives Considered
Any other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer your proposed solution.

## Additional Context
Screenshots, references to similar mods, or anything else that helps explain the idea.
